description: Imports a GPX file (absolute path) as a PRIVATE route in the user's Suunto account, which can then sync to the watch. Each <rte> or <trk> becomes its own route. Activities come from the `activities` argument, NOT the GPX (default [1] = running). Queued one at a time (about 3 s each) and read back: check.verified false with a note means the import went through but the read-back did not match; say so instead of reporting success. A route cannot be deleted through this server (use the Suunto app). Needs the Route API on the subscription. Write operation.

activities.description: Suunto activity IDs (1 = running; others in Suunto's Activities.pdf). Optional.

name: upload_route
title: Import GPX route
